meta.name: short-drama-knowhow
meta.description: 维护者专用的短剧 know-how 学习、验证与生命周期治理。仅在维护者明确要求从其当前会话提供的授权只读文本源学习完整短剧项目链，并把私有观察逐步转成去标识、去复刻、经盲测与独立审查的公共 reference、rubric 或 synthetic fixture 候选时使用；不用于普通创作、公开运行时取数、媒体生成或粗略数据分析。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把私有短剧观察整理成可公开验证的参考资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有授权只读的短剧项目资料,想沉淀成可公开的素材。
copy.tagline_en: Turn private short-drama notes into de-identified public references
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hold authorized short-drama material and want to publish safe reference assets

howto.what: 它会从你当前会话里已授权的只读文本源出发，逐层通读一部短剧项目链，写私有观察卡与决策卡、建题材×机制矩阵，再把观察去标识后整理成公共 reference、rubric 或合成 fixture 候选，先过盲测与独立审查再谈推广。
howto.when: 只在维护者明确要求、且当前会话已提供授权只读文本源时才接管；不用于普通创作、公开运行时取数、媒体生成等场景。

say.text: 读取我这次授权的只读文本源，通读这部短剧项目链并写私有观察卡。
say.note: 会先确认只读边界再开始。

say.text: 把这些观察做去标识处理，产出公共 reference 或 rubric 候选。
say.note: 候选先进 staging，不改公共资料。

say.text: 对这份候选做一次 fresh-agent 盲测和独立审查，再决定推广。

howto.what_en: It reads authorized read-only text sources, walks a full short-drama project chain, writes private observation cards and a coverage matrix, then turns de-identified findings into reference, rubric, or synthetic fixture candidates.
howto.when_en: Only when the maintainer explicitly asks and the session provides authorized read-only text sources. Not for ordinary writing, public runtime data pulls, or media generation.

say_en.text: Read my authorized sources and walk one short-drama chain into observation cards.
De-identify these findings and produce a public reference or rubric candidate.
say_en.note: Candidates stay in staging, not public.

say_en.text: Run a fresh-agent blind eval and independent review before promoting it.
say_en.note: If it fails, narrow or retire it.
